MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 18

2. Solve for x: x + 5 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 9
   C. 4
   D. 5

3. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 90

4. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 14

5. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

6. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 2, 3, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 1, 6
   D. 2, 4, 6

7. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 16
   C. 0
   D. 8

8. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 3
   C. 40
   D. 41

9. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

10. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 11
   C. 25
   D. 24

11. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 12
   C. 2
   D. 10

12. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 11
   C. 3
   D. 28

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: 9² = 9 × 9
3. 9² = 81
Final Answer: 81
